searchText: <CarlBeek> So I'm running up against the following error with SIWE on the `sequencer.ceremony.ethereum.org` deployment: `AuthErrorPayload - CouldNotExtractUserData could not extract user data from auth server`. the logs are clean on the server. any ideas what could be the culprit? Are you using a brand new Ethereum account? <CarlBeek> yes, but i have minimum nonce set to 0 I think I opened an issue for this a while back, you might need to disable the rpc call that tries to query what the nonce is <CarlBeek> hmm, ok will re-try with account with higher nonce <CarlBeek> hmm so i increased the `eth_min_nonce` and tried with an account with a high nonce and still the same error <CarlBeek> would this error occur if the eth rpc endpoint was poorly configured? question, where can be found the Sequencer server code? (to check the current API methods, and to run it locally for testing) <CarlBeek> https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer thanks! 🙏 <CarlBeek> np managed to add a contribution to the deployed sequencer (kzg-ceremony-sequencer-dev.fly.dev) authenticating with the github auth method, contributing to the ceremony from the custom go impl (https://github.com/arnaucube/eth-kzg-ceremony-alt)
